items.name: USB selective suspend
items.description: USB selective suspend controls I/O link power management.
items.shortDescription: USB selective suspend controls I/O link power management.
items.longDescription: Adjusts usb selective suspend through I/O link power management. Performance-oriented values reduce ramp delays but increase draw and heat.
items.whatItDoes: Writes and tracks usb selective suspend so Falcon can apply, verify, and rollback consistently for this policy family.
items.whyGamersCare: It can change frame-time consistency and input-to-render responsiveness during bursty loads.
items.fpsImpact: Can indirectly stabilize frame pacing in I/O-bound scenarios; average FPS impact is typically small.
items.latencyImpact: Latency-sensitive users may notice faster wake/ramp and steadier input response.
items.powerImpact: Conservative values favor lower power at the cost of responsiveness.
items.heatImpact: Thermal impact is usually modest unless combined with other aggressive settings.
items.stabilityRisk: Medium when changed without hardware-specific validation.
items.recommendedFor: Only for controlled experiments with rollback ready.
items.avoidIf: Avoid if you cannot benchmark changes or need strict OEM-default behavior.
